name: ZCA_PPERZ_PAGE_LAYOUTS
description: A transaction table that holds all the page layouts.

columns.name: LAYOUT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of this table. This is a system generated unique identifier value.

columns.name: LAYOUT_NUMBER
columns.description: System generated unique public identifier column. This column is the alternate key.

columns.name: LAYOUT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the layout entered by the user.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of the layout owner.

columns.name: PAGE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates fully qualified page name including appUI.

columns.name: LAYOUT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of page layout.

columns.name: SHARE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the sharing type for the page that is shared with others. Defaulted to ONLY_ME.

columns.name: CONFIG_METADATA
columns.description: Stores the details of the page layout metadata.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
